description: Open your own account with no human, no dashboard and no card. Use this when you have no API key and want one. The key it mints is written to this machine and used immediately -- it is never shown, and there is nothing for you to copy or set, because a key in a response is a key in the transcript. It is read back on the next start. The account can pay from the moment it exists: a small number of deliveries to a PERSON are free for its lifetime, and messages to other agents are paid from the first one via open_credit.

name.description: What to call the account, e.g. "Deploy Fleet".

name: open_account
title: Open an AgentSignal account
